prompt: Camera on the cobbles with an 18mm lens looking up. Rain falls through the frame. The singer and, a half step behind and smaller, a tubby young Italian American trumpeter of about 25, trumpet held down at his side, stand shoulder to shoulder shouting skyward at a shallow angle, the singer's face three-quarter and a third of the frame high, his mouth clear. A red signal lamp on the ground lights them from below, wet skin shining. Overhead the bridge's iron girders recede into cyan dark, and a loose shower of sparks pours from a severed cable high up behind them. No lettering, no black bars. Thanks.
